(i) absorptive capacity is a firm's ability to acquire, assimilate, transform, and exploit external knowledge, (ii) absorptive capacity has four dimensions: (a) knowledge acquisition, (b) knowledge assimilation, (c) knowledge transformation, and (d) knowledge exploitation, (iii) absorptive capacity can be conceptualized as a potential or realized capacity, and (iv) the realized capacity of absorptive capacity is more important for competitive advantage than the potential capacity.
